title: GraphQL model-version filtering: judge each version with _rm_or_prompt_read_predicate on the whole object and memoize the predicate per request
answers: Why does a prompt version show up or disappear in mlflowSearchModelVersions results depending on which grant I have?
Why is the GraphQL search for runs slow or makes many grant lookups when a run has many model versions?
Where are the per-user model-version permission predicates built for GraphQL responses?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:GraphQLAuthorizationMiddleware._model_version_read_predicate, used by _filter_model_versions_result for mlflowSearchModelVersions and by the nested modelVersions branch of _post_resolve. It covers any GraphQL response that returns model-version rows, which can include prompt versions.
Rule: Build the predicate with _rm_or_prompt_read_predicate(username) and call it with the whole model-version object, not with a name plus a registered_model predicate. A prompt version is then judged by prompt grants, the same as REST filter_search_model_versions. Store the predicate in Flask g under a username key, so mlflowSearchRuns, which resolves modelVersions once per run, does one user lookup and one grants query per request instead of one per run.
Symptom: The review flagged that filtering by registered-model grants alone let a registered_model wildcard reveal prompt-version metadata without a prompt grant, and hid prompts a user could read by prompt grant. Repeated predicate building per run caused N+1 authorization queries on the runs table, which requests up to 100 runs.
Constraints: The cache lives on the request context, so it is rebuilt for each request and never shared across users. Covered by test_graphql_search_model_versions_judges_prompts_by_prompt_grants in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py.
applies: GraphQL model-version results in the basic-auth server; not the REST model-version search filter, which has its own path.
says: The runs table loads extremely slowly when runs link to multiple model versions.
Users with prompt access cannot see their prompt versions in model version searches.
Registered model permissions incorrectly grant visibility into prompt versions without explicit prompt grants.
Evaluate prompt version visibility using prompt permissions rather than general model permissions.
search: GraphQL model-version authorization in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py evaluates model and prompt versions by passing the entire object to _rm_or_prompt_read_predicate and memoizing the predicate per request in Flask g. Applies to GraphQL responses returning model-version rows in the basic-auth server, including mlflowSearchModelVersions and nested modelVersions in _post_resolve, but not to REST model-version search. Filtering by prompt grants prevents registered-model wildcards from exposing prompt metadata and eliminates N+1 grant queries across runs in mlflowSearchRuns. The cache is scoped strictly to the request context and verified by test_graphql_search_model_versions_judges_prompts_by_prompt_grants in tests/server/auth/test_auth.py.
